notes.title: Finding Mojo! New gameplay video!
notes.notes: [p][/p][previewyoutube="tDj9dIZYXd8;full"][/previewyoutube][p]A little context. From December to April I’ve been working hard on alpha version feedback from players to make the demo better and release it this summer. [/p][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"]However, in May I have enlisted into the Armed Forces (I’ve been thinking on it for a while, but finally I had to make a decision).[/p][p][/p][p align="start"]But demo was nearing completion and a lot of things became way better:[/p][p align="start"]— reworked visual style;[/p][p align="start"]— reworked camera and controls;[/p][p align="start"]— lots of UI work;[/p][p align="start"]— reworked Sniff mode;[/p][p align="start"]— improved Stamina system;[/p][p align="start"]— dozens of models, textures and other assets; [/p][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"]I can go on and on. Now let’s cut to the chase — small treat is a short gameplay video of a single quest (one of dozen+ from the demo), called Finding Mojo. I hope you will like all the improvements that I’ve been working on. Every wishlist will keep the project alive and help me in finding time to work on it! Now, off we go, let’s find Mojo![/p]

notes.title: First nomination for Tailgate at IndieCup Ukraine 2024
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45058834/ce0113483400568b058660dfd5370cd94d5d2352.png[/img]

I'm very excited to share this with you! Not that I care about awars that much (but I'd lie if say I don't want any) but this nomination is quite special for several reasons! 

For starters, it's my very first recognition in game development. For this I am grateful!

Second, some people from the Jury are seasoned veterans of the industry, I've been reading their game reviews since I was a child and being recognised by them is a big thing for me personally.

More news will follow!

notes.title: Tailgate alpha gameplay footage for Ukrainian Games Festival
notes.notes:
Greetings! I worked hard to improve how Tailgate looks and feels compared to the prototype, so consider this a devlog Issue 1. What’s new:
[list]
[*]  updated visual (new textures, new and more unified assets, new hero and NPC look, “artistic“ shader);
[*] A couple of new mechanics and interactions, Hyde’s comments on environment and items, dialogue system;
[*] Introducing NPCs — Duchess (feline) and Mojo (pug). Mojo is a full NPC, he gives tasks to Hyde and later would accompany the player in this location.
[*] First location/chapter of the game — Hyde’s home and San Pedro village.
[/list]

It’s still an early footager, but you can see the changes if you compare to screenshots in the store page. I hope you will enjoy this short edit:
